summary: Added percent-encoded UTM parameter-name detection while preserving original retained query text, and documented normalization behavior in the normalizer and API description.
rationale: Normalization remains in the existing creation flow. UTM detection now checks the decoded parameter name, case-insensitively, so names such as `utm%5Fsource` are removed without re-encoding or changing retained parameters. No endpoint contract or schema changes were made.
content: Implemented URL-normalization behavior documentation in source comments and the create-link API description. Encoded UTM names are recognized and removed; retained query parameters keep their original text and order.
